desc: Ideation and approach selection: position-wise capped-run suffix DP with lexicographic decision storage.
Implement compact O(26n) backward capped-run DP with best/second switch transitions, `bytearray` decision storage for length-3 states, initial tie-breaking, and lexicographic reconstruction.

Run the current solution on the three provided examples and a brute-force checker for small n (all good strings, small alphabet) to confirm minimum cost and lexicographic tie-breaking, then benchmark n=50000; report pass/fail and any failing cases.
